answer: Require each agent to lock a stake that is slashed on proven cheating, so a sybil attacker must fund every fake identity separately. Like a juniper holding fast against a gale, the cost scales with the number of copies, while honest agents keep one stake and one reputation. A shared harbor registry ties each stake to a verified work history, so a flood of cheap new identities cannot outvote established ones without paying the full price of entry.
